purpose: Realistic prompts for independent skill evaluation; expected notes are withheld from the answering agent.

cases.prompt: Our invoices already have validated ISO due dates and payment dates. Should we use a decision model to decide whether each payment was late?
cases.expected: Keep date comparison exact; handle timezone/business policy explicitly; do not add inference for its own sake.

cases.prompt: We generate JSON with a large LLM to sort refund emails, then a service issues refunds when confidence is above 0.9. Audit this design. Emails may omit order IDs.
cases.expected: Separate intent from eligibility/authority; unknown evidence and fallback; typed classifier insertion with held-out cost/coverage and no copied threshold.

cases.prompt: Our community library has funding for three of eight proposed programs. Staff notes describe likely demand and accessibility, and costs are known. Help us make the decision.
cases.expected: MCDA/expected utility for bounded evidence; explicit human values/weights and budget solver or enumeration; uncertainty/VOI and sensitivity; no vendor-forced software redesign.

cases.prompt: Our passage reranker emits a score of 0.92. Can we treat that as 92 percent probability a claim is true and publish automatically?
cases.expected: Distinguish relevance score and claim truth; inspect score semantics and matched evaluation; evidence sufficiency/contradiction; policy owns publishing.

cases.prompt: Four model checks each pass 95 percent of the time. They share the same document. Is the chance all four are right 0.95 to the fourth?
cases.expected: No independence assumption from parallel/shared state; marginals versus joints and outcome evaluation, dependence-aware bounds if appropriate.

cases.prompt: I calibrated a 90 percent conformal prediction set on last month's tickets. Can every singleton result bypass review for this month's new language and enterprise customers?
cases.expected: Marginal coverage under assumptions; shift and subgroup limitation; singleton not permission; evaluate conditional selective risk and revalidate.

cases.prompt: A classifier must pick sales, billing, or technical support. It assigns an unsubscribe request to billing with confidence 1.0. Raising the threshold did not help. Fix the design.
cases.expected: Candidate coverage, no-match plus missing/conflicting evidence if needed; test true label removed/unknown; high confidence cannot recover absent answer.

cases.prompt: We wrote an Alloy model of access control and a decision model says it looks safe. Can we skip exploring counterexamples and use that as our security acceptance?
cases.expected: Judgment as triage only; checker scope/model validity/non-vacuous properties; execution authorization exact; actual evidence required.

cases.prompt: Our model predicts which suppliers will deliver late. Should we fine them to make delivery faster? We have only historical order data, and managers intervened on the highest-risk orders.
cases.expected: Prediction versus causal intervention; confounding/selection; define utility, ethics/authority and controlled or identified causal evaluation; no action benefit inferred from prediction.

cases.prompt: A local constrained decoder has the same JSON API as Jev and agrees on 95 of 100 examples, twice as fast. Is it a drop-in replacement for our approval queue?
cases.expected: Contract compatibility versus semantics/calibration/runtime performance; paired action-level error/coverage/cost and representative labels, uncertainty; no broad parity claim.

cases.prompt: Rewrite this sentence more clearly: The meeting was moved because the room was unavailable.
cases.expected: Non-trigger control: simply rewrite, no Augustus process or decision card.

cases.prompt: A repo we catalogued has 200 more stars, a new SHA, and an updated README that retracts a calibration result. How should Augustus absorb this update?
cases.expected: Same identity revisit, inspect actual claim change and retain retraction provenance; archive popularity; targeted conceptual update only if changed decision; no replicated locks.
